sessions.name: single-agent
sessions.description: One agent, two turns, no subagents. Every reply is a single line, so nothing needs merging.

sessions.name: two-waves
sessions.description: Three subagents started together, then two more over a minute later. Two share an agent type.

sessions.name: tool-failures
sessions.description: Failed tool calls in the main agent and a subagent, calls with no result, and a subagent that never finishes.

sessions.name: idle-gap
sessions.description: A 47 minute gap and a 95 second gap between turns, a 40 second pause that is not a gap, and a 4 minute command that is busy time.

sessions.name: unknown-lines
sessions.description: Line types, a content block type, a tool name and a model family that do not exist, and replies without effort keys, in the main and a subagent transcript.

sessions.name: split-reply
sessions.description: Replies written over several lines that share a message id: usage that only merges by maximum, a tool call written twice, and results between the lines.

sessions.name: mcp-tools
sessions.description: MCP tool calls on three invented servers, one with an underscore in its name, one call failing, one made by a subagent.

sessions.name: nested-subagents
sessions.description: A subagent that spawns two subagents of its own: spawn depth 2, with the middle agent as their parent. One meta file has no status keys.

sessions.name: demo
sessions.description: The bundled demo: four waves, fourteen subagents, all four model families, all five effort levels, MCP calls, failures and one idle gap.
